payload.title: Refusal reasons in judgment_bridge echo model-controlled values (side, ruling, verdict) with !r and no length cap into the BridgeContractRefused text, which the bridge writes whole into the governance ledger on every refused attempt.
evidence: aria-kernel/aria_kernel/judgment_bridge.py:253-264 (unknown_side, duplicate_side and ruling_invalid reasons interpolate the arbiter's own values with !r and no cap; a ruling can be any JSON value)
aria-kernel/aria_kernel/judgment_bridge.py:362 (the same unbounded echo of the verdict already exists on main)
aria-kernel/aria_kernel/agent_invocations.py:4883-4896 (the refusal text becomes the error field of an agent_bridge_warning governance row, whole)
aria-kernel/aria_kernel/tool_registry.py:693-708 (append_tools_governance appends the details as given, with no truncation)
aria-kernel/aria_kernel/agent_invocations.py:78 (the only upper bound on what a submission can carry is the 16 MiB artifact cap)
payload.rule_violated: Model-controlled values written to an append-only, hash-chained ledger need a bound at the writer (the predecessor-rejection carrier already caps each reason it re-feeds to a prompt at 400 characters, agent_invocations.py:1059).
payload.notes: A seat or an injected arbiter answer carries a side_rulings entry whose verdict or ruling is a multi-megabyte string. arbiter_side_rulings builds unknown_side:{side!r} or ruling_invalid:{ruling!r} from it, and the BridgeContractRefused text is appended whole to governance.jsonl on each bridge attempt; the review probe produced a 200,075 character message from a 200,000 character verdict. The same pattern exists for the verdict at judgment_bridge.py:362 on main, so the fix belongs to the family of !r refusal reasons, not to the two new sites alone. Close condition: One bounded-echo helper (value truncated to a fixed small length with a length marker) is used by every !r refusal reason in validate_judge_response and arbiter_side_rulings, and a test asserts that a 200,000 character verdict and a 200,000 character ruling yield refusal reasons shorter than 500 characters. Plan row: J3 (the F0.7 exit). Verified at head 3451f5c3fc of open pull request #2135; the cited code is not on main until that pull request merges.
